_doc: Methodology for contract/analysis.json — Act III (brief mechanics) and Act IV (substantiated argument & proposal). Not rendered on site; consumed by editors and harness/style_check.py. Pairs with contract/argument_writing.json (Acts I–II).

reference.pattern: Brief mechanics (frame, peril, two surfaces, model gap, discipline) → substantiated case → economics → wedge → register pricing → close

register.model: Act III explains how the peril and score work in ≤2 screens; Act IV prosecutes the case with cites and closes on commercial turn.
register.ratio: ≥85% industry / contract / underwriting mechanics; ≤15% index product mechanics (wedge paragraph only in Act IV).
register.sentence_mix: Short declarative thesis (≤12 words) then one machinery sentence. No 'This essay makes three claims'.

acts.title: The market asks who breaks? The grid asks who can be switched off?
sections: why cat and cyber miss it

macro_arc.question: What two axes replace a single hazard score?
macro_arc.deliver: Exposure vs Preparedness; Margin of Safety; framework block.

macro_arc.question: How does curtailment manifest in contracts?
macro_arc.deliver: No damage event; compound loss; eight-channel infirm profile (derating, compute utilisation, predictability, basis); basis risk on index trigger.

macro_arc.question: Why do cat and cyber models fail structurally?
macro_arc.deliver: No hazard footprint; wrong correlation substrate (grid geography).

macro_arc.question: How is outside-in scoring kept honest?
macro_arc.deliver: Source class per rating; register fusion; directional until L5 clears — one paragraph, link to methodology for pipeline.

macro_arc.question: What question has the industry answered for a century?
macro_arc.deliver: Damage → BI; wrong question for always-on load.

macro_arc.question: How large is the gap?
macro_arc.deliver: SLA math; load × hours × penalty; zero premium on availability.

macro_arc.question: What primitive and wedge implement the fix?
macro_arc.deliver: Two-axis map; measurement edge to write cover — not sell scores.

macro_arc.question: What reframe closes the essay?
macro_arc.deliver: Register moment; whitespace vs exposed; handoff to live data.
